title: Positive: no third-party requests or cookies before sign-in on public pages (local)
expected: No trackers or non-essential storage before consent.
actual: On /landing, /login, /register, /marketplace, /businesses, /feed and /nearby a first-time visitor triggers zero requests to other hosts and no cookies; only a language preference (empire_lang) is stored. No analytics or ad tags exist in source. Backend production config sets a deny-all CSP and one-year HSTS; CORS rejects untrusted origins. Caveat: Google sign-in, Sentry and map tiles are not configured locally — production behaviour is UNVERIFIED (F-029).
impact: No cookie banner is legally required today; re-check when analytics are added.
